practical_race_plan: Use the live GT7/GTSH race configuration as the regulatory baseline.
Treat Lap 4-5 only as the initial reference. If tyre condition and traffic remain favourable, extend the first stint and exploit the overcut.
Protect the tyres in the opening stint: minimise sliding, excess steering angle and unnecessary front-axle load.
Use RM -> RS: start on Racing Medium, preserve the tyre, then switch to Racing Soft for the second stint.
